---
title: "Concert Attendance Project"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(readr)

# Load data
attend <- read_csv("fulllog.csv", col_types = cols())

clean_attend <- attend %>%
  
  # --- Clean Total Count ---
  mutate(
    `Total Count` = parse_number(`Total Count`)
  ) %>%
  
  # Keep only rows with valid total counts
  filter(!is.na(`Total Count`)) %>%
  
  # --- Standardize Date ---
  mutate(
    `Day/Date` = parse_date_time(
      `Day/Date`,
      orders = c("mdy", "m/d/y", "m/d/Y"),
      exact = FALSE
    ) %>% as.Date()
  ) %>%
  
  # --- Standardize Time ---
  mutate(
    Time = case_when(
      is.na(Time) ~ NA_character_,
      str_detect(Time, "^\\d{1,2}:\\d{2}") ~
        format(parse_date_time(Time, orders = c("H:M", "I:M p")), "%H:%M"),
      str_detect(Time, "^\\d{1,2}\\s*(AM|PM|am|pm)$") ~
        format(parse_date_time(Time, orders = c("I p")), "%H:%M"),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_  # junk values removed
    )
  )

# View cleaned data
glimpse(clean_attend)

```
